description: This file defines the WebAppCache class responsible for caching web application information retrieved from component configurations in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for retrieving web app info based on server name, menu, and web app name, primarily to improve performance by avoiding repeated configuration retrievals. The class includes mechanisms for thread-safe caching and shared singleton instance.

classes.name: WebAppCache
classes.description: A cache for web application information in OFBiz, supporting retrieval based on server and menu names, with internal synchronization for thread safety.

methods.name: WebAppCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a supplier for component configurations.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfos
methods.description: Retrieves web application info list for a specified server and optional menu, with caching to improve performance.

methods.name: getWebappInfo
methods.description: Finds the first web application info matching the provided server and web app name.

methods.name: getShared
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of WebAppCache.
